name: YES? or YES!
tagline: Call a phone number and real fish in a tank pick which bad decision a computer then carries out in your life.
problem: Played for laughs: the team wanted the most absurd possible use of the weekend.
solution: A Twilio voice agent (Deepgram, Claude Haiku, ElevenLabs) offers two bad options; camera blob detection reads where the guppies swim; a second laptop executes the winning action such as a message or a post.
demo_moment: Team-described: a live call, the countdown on the TV behind the tank, and the action firing.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Questionable Use of 36 Hours” among 307 submissions.
Commits fully to an absurd premise with real consequences.
Won Most Questionable Use of 36 Hours.

lessons: Humour prizes reward commitment: real fish, a real call, a real action.
